description: The SPECIAL-NAMES DYNAMIC LENGTH STRUCTURE clause, ISO 12.3.7.2 - DYNAMIC LENGTH [STRUCTURE] dynamic-length-structure-name-1 [IS] {[SIGNED] [SHORT] PREFIXED | DELIMITED (choice indicators) | physical-structure-name-1} - the physical layout a DYNAMIC LENGTH clause may name (13.18.19.3 SR2). Introduced with dynamic-length elementary items (the dynamic-length-item-2014 row; no VCR row, Annex E covering 2014-2023 only). LIVE (kb/Work PB829): the name is declared and inherited by contained source elements; its PREFIXED length field bounds the item's maximum size (8.5.1.10.1) and the LIMIT phrase (SR4); physical-structure-names are an implementor set WiseOwl COBOL leaves empty (12.3.7.3 SR32, COBOL2257). Parse-arm gated on recognition (VisitDynamicLengthStructureClause).
vcr: 2014 introduction, with the DYNAMIC LENGTH clause it serves (dynamic-length-item-2014 - the same provisional 2014 edge)
source:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. DLS.
ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
CONFIGURATION SECTION.
SPECIAL-NAMES.
    DYNAMIC LENGTH STRUCTURE DLS1 IS SHORT PREFIXED.
DATA DIVISION.
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
01 W-D PIC X DYNAMIC LENGTH DLS1 LIMIT IS 20.
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    MOVE "HELLO" TO W-D.
    DISPLAY W-D.
    STOP RUN.
